findings.title: Where the error lives
findings.read: Volume is the larger source of error (51.55 yds from volume vs 45.05 from rate). Fix the volume model first; tuning the other half cannot recover this.

findings.title: Volume bias
findings.read: We OVER-project attempts by 0.12 per player (projected 31.78, actual 31.66).

findings.title: Rate bias
findings.read: yards per attempt is over-projected by 0.01 (projected 7.2, actual 7.18).

findings.title: Opponent adjustment is costing accuracy
findings.read: Error with the adjustment 63.52, without it 63. Removing it would be more accurate on this sample.

findings.title: Against the closing line
findings.read: Beat the line on 103/252 (40.87%). Our MAE 62.83 vs the line's 58. The book is the better projection.
